This text appears to be in the Coptic language, which uses a script based on the Greek alphabet. I'll provide an English translation of the text:

"Jesus said to them: 'Why do you not understand my speech? Because you are unable to hear my word. You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks out of his own character, for he is a liar and the father of lies.'"

This passage is a translation of a portion of John 8:43-44 from the New Testament. The Coptic language was spoken in Egypt from late antiquity until the Middle Ages, and it was used in Christian texts like this one.
